dimensions.assessment: Affects veterans enrolled in the VA health care system who have been diagnosed with Parkinson's disease or a similar movement disorder and elect to participate.
dimensions.evidence: furnish boxing-based exercise classes to a veteran... if the veteran--(1) is enrolled in the health care system... (2) has been diagnosed with a covered movement disorder

dimensions.assessment: Provides a specific therapeutic exercise option either at VA medical facilities or via reimbursement at non-VA facilities for qualifying individuals.
dimensions.evidence: through the provision of such classes to the veteran at a medical facility of the Department or the reimbursement for such classes provided to the veteran at a non-Department facility

dimensions.assessment: Requires the VA to fund or reimburse classes for eligible participants, but does not state aggregate expenditure amounts.
Amends Subchapter II of chapter 17 of title 38, United States Code, to add a specific medical service category.
dimensions.evidence: Subchapter II of chapter 17 of title 38, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent coverage requirement for VA medical services starting 180 days after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: shall apply with respect to medical services furnished on or after the date that is 180 days after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: The exact number of veterans diagnosed with Parkinson's disease or similar movement disorders who will utilize the benefit is not stated.
The total expected cost to the VA is not quantified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to furnish boxing-based exercise classes to eligible veterans diagnosed with Parkinson's disease or similar movement disorders, impacting enrolled veterans with those specific conditions and VA healthcare operations.
